notes: Cliopatria has no Butua. Budget: one page (the state's article). Not settled: the date Khami became the capital; the 1450 Great Zimbabwe gain (page silent, confidence 1); the extent toward the Makgadikgadi Pan. Portuguese records of 1520 'state that Butua was a vassal of Mwenemutapa' (the Mutapa page also notes 4,000 cows gifted in 1493) but the same page has Butua warring on Mutapa until 1512, so no vassal event is entered. The 'Torwa dynasty' is one dynasty within the state; 'Rozvi' is a new state (rozvi-empire), not a rename, because the page says Changamire 'founded the Rozwi Empire' with its capital at Danamombe. No area is given by the page. Gazetteer: all names resolve (region Matabeleland, place Great Zimbabwe).
